title: Neutral late-year versus central aggregate mean revenue loss

claims.text: The neutral late-year scenario yields a slightly smaller aggregate mean revenue loss than the central scenario, a scenario difference and not a causal attribution or an occurrence probability.

limitations: Scenario variants are sensitivity alternatives and are not assigned occurrence probabilities; they do not bracket a calibrated credible interval.
The assessment is conditional on the forecast vintage and model scope; it does not represent total-economy loss or sovereign default probability.
Mean values are signed mean losses (neutral revenue minus event revenue); this comparison uses means only and does not address VaR or ES tail measures.
Historical input provenance is incomplete; the assessment is for inspection only and is not recomputable.
